proves.claim: proofShardPlan returns the runner, files, cores, account and only the declared proof files as timing.

cli.io-submit-pull.proof-shard-plan-timi.why: Without it a timing-declared proof file never reaches the board as its own exclusive shard.

proves.claim: proofShardPlan returns null when the files fit the cores and none is declared, and a plan when one is declared.

cli.io-submit-pull.proof-shard-plan-with.why: Without it a proof within the cores shards needlessly or a declared file stays in the loaded gate job.

proves.claim: The gate entry reads timing files through main's gate door only when it exports them, treats a throw as none, and builds proofPlan through proofShardPlan.

cli.io-submit-pull.entry-reads-timing-th.why: Without it an older main or a throw breaks the gate entry, or the declaration never reaches the plan.
